arc.fallback: The Miasma of the Void, Vanilla Ice

description.fallback: As Polnareff and Iggy run from Vanilla Ice, they spot the entrance. Polnareff realizes that he can easily escape from the mansion, and probable death, but knows in his heart that he must confront DIO. The two run up more stairs, getting closer and closer to the master of the house.
